stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes oogenesis from spermatogenesis in humans?
options: Oogenesis starts at puberty, and each primary oocyte yields four equal ova
Oogonia form only before birth, and the meiotic divisions of the oocyte are unequal
Primary oocytes finish meiosis I before birth, so the fetal ovary has secondary oocytes
The oocyte completes meiosis II inside the Graafian follicle before it is ovulated
